verdict.rationale: Apple provides official Mac Help guide content and Migration Assistant/Setup Assistant features aimed at PC switchers (macos-docs-1, macos-docs-2, macos-docs-14), but there's no evidence of dedicated guided/interactive tutorials for OS installation or desktop interface learning, and community feedback highlights confusing window management and UX regressions that would challenge switchers (macos-comm-5, macos-comm-7, macos-comm-9).
